$comment: The guest's proposed ABI for P6 (deckpilot.scripts 0.1.0, knittingcode/deckpilot-plugins official/scripts): every request the guest sends, as it sends it, and a representative reply of each op.

The guest's tests (official/scripts/src/tests_fixture.rs) drive the real prelude and marshallers against a mock bridge and assert that every request they emit equals the request here byte for byte, in canonical JSON (compact, object keys sorted bytewise), that every request is under maxRequestBytes and every reply under maxReplyBytes, and that the guest accepts every reply.

DeckPilot's ABI crate (plugins/runtime/crates/abi) is to test that it parses every request here into its CapabilityRequest variants (deny_unknown_fields) and that its reply types serialize to these shapes.
A reply is {"ok": value} or {"error": {code: CallErrorCode, message, script?: {code: ErrorCode, message, repository?, command?, path?, confirmation?: {token}}}}.

Chunked I/O (P6 decision D1): fs.readFile reads at most readChunkBytes per call; fs.writeFile is fs.write.open, fs.write.chunk (at most writeChunkBytes of data each) and fs.write.commit, or fs.write.abort. The wire encoding of file data is always base64.
